answer: To secure an economy of autonomous AI agents against Sybil attacks without central authority, networks utilize decentralized stake-weighted consensus. Akin to a falcon patrolling its territory, cryptographic protocols verify unique compute nodes. As economic value rises like a high tide, staking requirements scale dynamically. Every fraudulent identity requires locking substantial capital, ensuring the cost of deploying fake agents vastly outweighs any potential network reward, protecting the system at its economic summit.
